about: Labelled passages for paste tracking. 'expect' is what a person would call it: 'exact' (taken over word for word), 'near' (taken over and lightly changed) or null (the author's own, too short to tell, or never compared).
question: Is my methods section complete?
document:
## Methods

We recruited 48 participants from two offices in the same city.
They took walking breaks or stayed seated.
answer:
Line 3 says "We recruited 48 participants from two offices in the same city." but not how they were assigned. A reader will want to know whether assignment was random and who carried it out.

[AI-TEXT] Participants were randomly assigned to the walking or the sitting condition by a colleague who was not involved in data collection.

You could check this source yourself:
Smith, J. (2020). Walking breaks and attention in office workers during long meetings. Journal of Work, 12(3), 45-67. https://doi.org/10.1000/xyz

```r
assignment <- sample(rep(c("walk", "sit"), each = 24)) # shuffles the two conditions over all of the participants
```
